def _finite_real(value: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:

def propagate_exponential_memory(history: np.ndarray, durations: np.ndarray, tau: np.ndarray, *, initial: np.ndarray | None = None) -> np.ndarray:
    """Return terminal memory (n,m) for finite real histories (n,k) in chronological order, nonnegative durations (k,), positive tau (m,), and optional finite real initial memory (n,m)."""

        raise ValueError('history and durations must share the interval axis')
    if q.ndim != 1 or not q.size or np.any(q <= 0) or np.any(dt < 0):
        raise ValueError('need positive relaxation times and nonnegative durations')
    shape = (h.shape[0], q.size)
    z = np.zeros(shape) if initial is None else _finite_real(initial).copy()
    if z.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError('initial memory must have shape (n,m)')
    with np.errstate(over='ignore', under='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
        x = -dt[:, None] / q
        decay, fill = np.exp(x), -np.expm1(x)
        for j in range(h.shape[1]):

    if not np.isfinite(z).all():
        raise FloatingPointError('terminal memory is not finite')
    return z


def evaluate_exponential_hold(memory: np.ndarray, hold: np.ndarray, times: np.ndarray, tau: np.ndarray, weights: np.ndarray, drift: np.ndarray, baseline: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:

def verify_initial_rate(memory: np.ndarray, hold: np.ndarray, tau: np.ndarray, weights: np.ndarray, drift: np.ndarray, rate: np.ndarray, *, rtol: float = 1e-10, atol: float = 1e-12) -> np.ndarray:
